svg.title: What it won't do
svg.desc: What it won't do, each line stamped no while the refused things tumble down a shaft: fix everything in one go, pipe a remote script into PowerShell, install a registry cleaner, install a PC optimizer, run a debloat script or a tweak pack, switch off Defender, the firewall or UAC, add an antivirus exclusion because a tool asks, run heavy disk work on a failing disk before a backup. Each no comes with one sentence on why and the safe built-in alternative.
